decision_scope: Whether Enforced Planning provides an opt-in, exact-revision structural planning gate whose sanctioned Make, direct-claim, worktree-helper, and session activation paths preserve one truthful custody chain.

contract.coverage_nonclaim: PASS proves the declared planning-integrity structure, not that every material area was named or that the plan is optimal.

focused_verification.command: env -u CODEX_THREAD_ID -u CLAUDE_SESSION_ID -u OPENCLAW_SESSION_ID -u OPENCLAW_RUN_ID pytest -q tests/test_validate_plan.py tests/test_plan_readiness.py tests/test_check_coordination_claims.py tests/test_session_contracts.py tests/test_session_cli.py tests/test_create_worktree.py tests/test_install_governed_repo.py --maxfail=20
focused_verification.targeted_lint: ruff E9/F63/F7/F82 passed on every changed Python boundary and test file
focused_verification.source_meta_parity: session_start.py and create_worktree.py canonical/installed mirrors are byte-identical

both_sign_controls.complete_structure: pass with retained acceptance, frontier, reassessment, exact plan digest, and executing-validator digest
both_sign_controls.observe_mode: allows graph-ready work while printing the full typed result and finding codes at the authentic installed Make boundary
both_sign_controls.new_non_tip_resume: denied; --resume is not evidence for a new old-revision claim, even with matching branch/worktree artifacts
both_sign_controls.direct_helper_revision_omission: denied; helper-resolved revision is compared with every plan-bound reservation when --claim-start-revision is omitted
both_sign_controls.claim_activation_mismatch: denied when an activated claim names A and its branch/worktree execute B
both_sign_controls.legacy_claim_migration: denied; a running v3 claim without start_revision cannot be relabeled as historical v4 custody
both_sign_controls.ownership_race: session-start rollback preserves a branch created between claim admission and worktree-helper execution
both_sign_controls.markdown_ambiguity: duplicate governed headings reject across supported CommonMark ATX indentation/closing hashes and both supported bold-field forms
both_sign_controls.canonical_template_syntax: the authored **Disposition:** value form passes; the prior inline form remains explicitly compatible
both_sign_controls.worktree_only_install: advertised readiness CLI executes with its transitive dependency closure

independent_review.verdict: implementation ACCEPT; prior evidence REVISE until this exact receipt was regenerated

installer.staged_activation: revision-bound claim reservation without tracker, then exact worktree creation, then tracker-bearing session activation or ownership-receipt rollback

known_followup.runtime_binding: PI-02C will bind selected outcome continuation to the accepted plan revision using the existing immutable outcome-contract baseline.
known_followup.operator_documentation: PI-02D will update docs/guides/WORKTREE_COORDINATION_OPERATOR_GUIDE.md and GETTING_STARTED.md, the two exact documentation couplings reported by the provider commit hook.

consumer_sequencing.rule: An independently valuable project rewrite may advance while affected AES controls remain measured; authentic failures return as focused regressions rather than becoming a platform-completion gate.

promotion_boundary: This receipt accepts PI-02's exact provider candidate only. PI-02C runtime binding, PI-02D operator documentation, installed AES consumption, fleet enforcement, planning optimality, and stable public 1.0 guarantees remain unproved.
